title: Luke Air Force Base Recreation Area

services.name: Yurt
services.desc: These aren’t your typical cabins, but they do make you feel at one with nature. Set up like studio style apartments they have all you need for a mini vacation with your loved ones. There is a queen sized bed, pull out couch, TV, microwave, kitchenette, and bathroom in every unit. The cabins have a small porch, picnic table and charcoal grill. Although they be small they are great for a simple weekend or weekday getaway. Our pet friendly Cabin is a bit different because this unit only accommodates up to three people, plus a furry friend. The pet friendly Cabin has one queen sized bed plus a twin sized roll way with a TV and DVD player. We have two pet-friendly cabin; $25 for the first night,

explain.meaning: A round, tent-like cabin with a wooden floor.

blurb: We invite you to experience our rustic elegance, fresh air, and beautiful scenery. There are so many ways to stay here at Fort Tuthill. From lodge rooms to cabins, and A-Frame lodges to Yurts, you’re guaranteed to be nice and cozy.
